02 — How I work

Research first. Craft always.

I like problems that don't arrive neatly scoped. My job is to find the real constraint, then design the smallest, clearest thing that resolves it.

01

Research before pixels

I start with the messy part — interviews, competitive teardowns and the language people actually use. Opinions are cheap; patterns aren't.

02

Structure over decoration

Hierarchy, flows and states come first. Visual polish is the last 20% of the work, not the first thing I reach for.

03

Craft that survives build

I prototype in Figma, speak enough code to design within real constraints, and document decisions engineers can act on.

03 — About

A designer who likes the messy middle.

More about me

I came to design through AI and software. That path left me with two habits that show up in every project: I ask how something will be built before I fall in love with how it looks, and I don't trust a decision until I've watched someone use it.
